content:
olivia: drafting a short, copy-paste manager checklist for first-week + 30/60/90. want it one-paragraph friendly for calendar invites. thoughts?

sam: love the one-paragraph idea. suggest adding an explicit "who-to-contact" line for IT, security, and payroll. saves time when things break.

olivia: good call. adding: contact #it-ops for hardware/SSO, #security for certs, people-ops for payroll. also including a tiny Day1 1:1 agenda: expectations, comms prefs, immediate blockers, first-week priorities.

onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: manager Day1 checklist email will be sent 24h before start.

sam: perfect. paste-ready draft below.

```
Manager one-paragraph kickoff (paste into calendar/email):
Please welcome [Name]. Pre-start: open IT ticket for laptop/SSO, assign buddy, and share role doc + OKRs. Day1: HR walkthrough (payroll/benefits), 20m manager 1:1 (expectations, communication preferences, immediate blockers, 3-week focus), quick team intro, and tech-access check with buddy. By EOW: confirm repo/tests run, assign first small task, review 30/60/90. Contacts: #it-ops for hardware/SSO, #security for compliance, people-ops for payroll. Customer shadow/support ridealong in week 2 recommended.
```
_notes: Single Slack thread per agents.md: messages concatenated; no title field.
